name: so-cross-border-residence
description: Somalia cross-border residence intake for 2026 preparation from Income Tax Act 37/2025, articles 77 and 78, with the Ministry's English manual as a reading aid. Use it to distinguish permanent-home, citizenship, 183-day and government-posting tests, then screen partnerships, trusts and corporations including effective management. It produces a dated domestic residence and transition-facts schedule and a handoff for source, PE, treaty and tax computation work. It does not turn fewer than 183 days into automatic non-residence, equate a foreign company registry with foreign tax residence or calculate exit tax. Income Tax Regulation 0142-2025 adds nothing to articles 77 or 78, but postponement notices and circulars are unchecked, so final 2026 application remains gated. Two executable day-count decisions accompany the statutory rules. Independent source review accepted the statutory baseline only; professional attestation remains pending.
